calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id < 900 AS is_store, (f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01') AS after_change, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, sum(net_amount) AS net,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id < 900) AS ctrl_before_returns,
 min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at),
 sum(CASE WHEN channel_code <> 'ST' OR channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_st
FROM l

calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' AS src, ROUND(f.vat_rate*100,1) AS vat_rate_pct, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'refunds', ROUND(r.vat_rate*100,1), count(*), sum(r.refund_net), sum(r.refund_gross), sum(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2
